modes.label: Write new email
modes.description: Turn a few notes into a complete, ready-to-send email.
modes.main_placeholder: Example: Ask my manager for Friday off to attend a family event. I will finish the report before I leave.

modes.label: Reply to an email
modes.description: Paste the email you received and say how you want to answer.
modes.main_label: How do you want to reply?
modes.main_placeholder: Example: Accept the meeting on Thursday at 3 pm, but ask them to send the agenda first.

modes.label: Improve my draft
modes.description: Polish clarity, tone and grammar without changing your meaning.
modes.main_placeholder: Example: Make it clearer and more polite. Keep it short.

modes.label: Follow-up email
modes.description: Send a polite nudge after no reply, a meeting or an interview.
modes.main_label: What are you following up on?
modes.main_placeholder: Example: I sent a proposal last Monday and have not heard back. I want to ask if they need anything else.

modes.label: Subject lines
modes.description: Get eight subject line options that people actually open.
modes.main_placeholder: Example: Announcing our new pricing plans for existing customers, effective next month.
